phases.name: Wild West — Complete
phases.summary: Completed Borgarnes base with charger recovery, Borgarfjörður geothermal stops and Snæfellsnes catch-up.

items.title: Charger recovery handled
items.desc: Borgarnes → Reykjavík → Borgarnes, then Deildartunguhver/Reykholt and Hraunfossar/Barnafoss where timing allowed.

items.title: Snæfellsnes loop
items.desc: Arnarstapi-Hellnar, Kirkjufell/Grundarfjörður and optional basalt/coastal stops moved into the catch-up day.

phases.name: North — Complete
phases.summary: Completed Akureyri base with town recovery, Goðafoss, Mývatn geology, Bjarnaflag Geothermal Power Station and Krafla Power Station. The southbound Krafla-to-Selfoss drive is now shown as the Phase 3 weather extension, not Phase 2 core.

items.title: Akureyri recovery base
items.desc: Town walk, harbor, café time and Forest Lagoon fit the colder-weather North Iceland day.

items.title: Mývatn geology + power stations
items.desc: Goðafoss, Hverir/Námafjall, Dimmuborgir, Mývatn Nature Baths, Bjarnaflag Geothermal Power Station, Krafla Power Station and Krafla/Víti area.

phases.name: Phase 2 Extension to Selfoss
phases.summary: Weather-adjusted route: continue the same Phase 2 Route 1 corridor from the Krafla/Mývatn side, route through Reykjavík, and then extend south/east to Selfoss for compact add-on stops.

items.title: Same Route 1 corridor as Phase 2
items.desc: Stay on the practical Route 1 corridor from the Akureyri/Mývatn side, force Reykjavík as the routing waypoint, then continue to Selfoss.

items.title: Selfoss add-ons after arrival
items.desc: Use Gullfoss, Kerið, Faxi, Hveragerði/Eyrarbakki, Seljalandsfoss, Skógafoss and Reynisfjara as weather/energy add-ons from the Selfoss base.

phases.name: Deep South Big East Run
phases.summary: Big east run from Hvolsvöllur to Jökulsárlón, Diamond Beach and back, then drive directly to Reykjavík.

items.title: Urriðafoss first
items.desc: Quick early stop for the missed high-flow waterfall before committing east on Route 1.

items.title: Glacier lagoon priority
items.desc: Jökulsárlón and Diamond Beach first, then Reynisfjara, Skógafoss and Kvernufoss on the westbound return.

items.title: May 12 — Back to Reykjavík
items.desc: Morning LAVA Centre, then direct drive up Route 1 to Reykjavík. Hallgrímskirkja, Harpa, Old Harbour and seafood dinner.

items.title: May 12 — Back to Reykjavík
items.desc: Direct drive west on Route 1 from Hvolsvöllur back to Reykjavík. Hallgrímskirkja, Harpa, Old Harbour and seafood dinner.

phases.name: Reykjavík Return & Departure
phases.summary: City rest day, then departure day Reykjanes loop: Grindavík, Garður Old Lighthouse, HSS hospital visit, EV top-up and fly home from KEF.

items.title: May 13–14 — Reykjavík city days
items.desc: National Museum, Perlan, Settlement Exhibition, Laugavegur and evening jazz/blues.

items.title: May 15 — Departure via Reykjanes
items.desc: Check out 8:30 AM, Grindavík coast, Garður Old Lighthouse, HSS Suðurnes Hospital 10:00 AM, EV charge + car return at KEF, FI631 KEF 17:10 → BOS 18:50.

stops.name: Bjarnaflag Geothermal Power Station
stops.note: Phase 2 power-station visit near the Mývatn geothermal area.

stops.name: Krafla Power Station
stops.note: Phase 2 geothermal power-station visit near Krafla.

stops.name: Krafla / Víti area
stops.note: Krafla volcano / Víti crater area paired with the power-station coverage.

stops.name: Reykjavík waypoint for Phase 3 extension
stops.note: Required waypoint forcing Leg 19 to use the practical Route 1 corridor through Reykjavík before continuing to Selfoss.

stops.name: HSS Suðurnes Hospital
stops.note: 10:00 AM hospital tour on departure day. ER 24/7 · +354 422 0500 · Skólavegur 6, Reykjanesbær

stops.name: KEF Airport
stops.note: Icelandair FI631 KEF 17:10 → BOS 18:50. EV charging: ISAVIA Leifstöð 50kW on site.

turns.title: Leg 19 Reykjavík routing correction
turns.text: Leg 19 is now forced through Reykjavík: Krafla/Víti area → Reykjavík → Selfoss. This prevents the map engine from drawing a shorter inland route and keeps Phase 3 on the practical Route 1 corridor.

turns.title: Leg 19 correction
turns.text: Leg 19, Krafla/Víti area → Reykjavík → Selfoss, is assigned to Phase 3 as the weather-forced southbound extension of the Phase 2 Route 1 corridor.

turns.title: Weather update: Phase 3 follows Phase 2 route plus extension
turns.text: Due to weather, Phase 3 uses the same practical Route 1 corridor as Phase 2, forces the route through Reykjavík, and then extends to Selfoss. Golden Circle and South Coast items are optional add-ons from the Selfoss base.

turns.title: Power-station coverage added
turns.text: The May 8 north segment now shows Bjarnaflag Geothermal Power Station and Krafla Power Station as distinct visits, with Krafla/Víti as the nearby geology stop before the southbound extension.

turns.title: Completed Phase 1 adjustment
turns.text: The charger recovery moved May 4 into a practical Borgarnes–Reykjavík–Borgarnes recovery day with Borgarfjörður geothermal stops, while the Snæfellsnes loop moved to May 5.

turns.title: North Iceland cold-weather adjustment
turns.text: Akureyri stayed useful as a warm recovery base: town walk, harbor/cafés and Forest Lagoon, with Goðafoss/Mývatn kept to the strongest weather window.

turns.title: Weather-forced southbound route
turns.text: Phase 3 is the weather-forced continuation of the Phase 2 Route 1 corridor, extended south to Selfoss. Keep side trips compact and optional.

turns.title: May 10 Selfoss priority order
turns.text: Go to Gullfoss first while weather holds, then Faxi only if it fits, Kerið on the southbound return, and keep Hveragerði/Eyrarbakki culture stops as warm indoor options.

turns.title: May 11 big east run rule
turns.text: Base at Hvolsvöllur. Start early, keep Urriðafoss short, prioritize Jökulsárlón and Diamond Beach, then use Reynisfjara, Skógafoss and Kvernufoss as westbound return stops only if energy and conditions stay good.

turns.title: May 12 Reykjavík return
turns.text: Use the LAVA Centre before checkout, then return west on Route 1. Garður Old Lighthouse is optional and should be skipped if it threatens a relaxed Reykjavík arrival.

turns.title: May 13 Walter Mitty day
turns.text: From Reykjavík, take Route 1 north and Route 54 west to Snæfellsnes for Stykkishólmur/Walter Mitty bridge, Kirkjufell and Arnarstapi-Hellnar, then return to Reykjavík.

days.title: Arrive Reykjavík → Borgarnes
days.plan: Drive to Borgarnes base, check in, evening walk and reset.

days.title: Charger recovery + Borgarfjörður
days.drive: 152 km charger round trip + local loop
days.plan: Borgarnes → Reykjavík → Borgarnes for the laptop charger. Afternoon: Deildartunguhver, Reykholt and Hraunfossar/Barnafoss if timing allowed.

days.title: Snæfellsnes catch-up loop
days.plan: Arnarstapi-Hellnar coastal path, Kirkjufell/Grundarfjörður and optional Gerðuberg basalt cliffs.

days.title: Borgarnes → Akureyri
days.plan: Route 1 north via Varmahlíð. Evening Akureyri town walk, harbor, cafés or Forest Lagoon.

days.title: Goðafoss + Mývatn geology
days.plan: Goðafoss, Lake Mývatn, Hverir/Námafjall, Dimmuborgir and Mývatn Nature Baths.

days.title: Power stations, then Phase 3 extension via Reykjavík
days.drive: Akureyri → Bjarnaflag → Krafla, then Krafla → Reykjavík → Selfoss
days.plan: Capture Bjarnaflag Geothermal Power Station, Krafla Power Station and Krafla/Víti area as Phase 2 coverage. Leg 19 then forces the practical Route 1 corridor through Reykjavík before continuing to Selfoss as the Phase 3 weather extension.

days.title: Arrive Selfoss via Phase 2 extension
days.drive: Route 1 southbound extension + optional arrival stops
days.plan: Complete the weather-forced extension to Selfoss using the same Route 1 corridor as Phase 2. Add Seljalandsfoss, Skógafoss and Reynisfjara only as weather and energy allow after arrival.

days.title: Selfoss add-on day
days.drive: Compact Golden Circle / local loop from Selfoss
days.plan: Treat Gullfoss, optional Faxi, Kerið, LÁ Art Museum, Greenhouse Café and dinner as add-ons from Selfoss rather than the main Phase 3 route.

days.title: Hvolsvöllur big east run
days.plan: Leave early: Urriðafoss, Jökulsárlón, Diamond Beach, Reynisfjara, Skógafoss/Kvernufoss, then back to Hvolsvöllur.

days.title: Drive back to Reykjavík
days.plan: Drive west on Route 1 from Hvolsvöllur back to Reykjavík (~131 km). Arrive early afternoon. Hallgrímskirkja, Harpa, Old Harbour and seafood dinner.

days.title: Reykjavík city day
days.plan: National Museum, Perlan, Settlement Exhibition, Laugavegur shopping, Tjörnin lake walk and weather-dependent Nauthólsvík or live jazz/blues evening.

days.title: Departure — Reykjavík → KEF → Boston
days.plan: Check out by 8:30 AM. Quick Grindavík coast stop, Garður Old Lighthouse photo stop, HSS Suðurnes Hospital tour at 10:00 AM (Skólavegur 6, Reykjanesbær). EV top-up at ISAVIA Leifstöð at KEF. Car return by noon. Lunch at terminal. Clear security by 4:00 PM. Icelandair FI631 · KEF 17:10 → BOS 18:50 · Conf: BUTUWM.
